acceptedEvidence: Mechanics, full-session context and structure pass. The F1/O1/O2 resolutions and the O3 decline are supported by the revised 督 card. The new optional point (split the urging bullet) is accepted as optional; its count says nine but lists eleven characters, a non-consequential miscount.

openClaims.reason: The report correctly labels 連, 養 and 習 as unverified, but its CONFIRMED verdict treated that limit as non-consequential. Primary Daijisen entries show 連 and 養 carry senses that the card's own guard policy already excludes (引 for taking someone along; 育 for training).

連.basis: KANJIDIC2 'lead' and Daijisen 引きつれる; consistent with the existing 引 guard.
sourceText: ３ 引きつれる。「連行・連立」

養.basis: Daijisen 精神的な糧を与えてりっぱに育てる (養成); consistent with the existing 育 training guard.
sourceText: ３ 精神的な糧を与えてりっぱに育てる。「養成／涵養(かんよう)・教養・修養・素養」

習.basis: Only self-learning and custom senses; no instructing-others, urging or supervising sense.
sourceText: １ 繰り返して行って身につける。ならう。なれる。「習作・習字・習熟・習得／演習・温習・学習・既習・講習・自習・実習・復習・練習」
２ 繰り返し行ってきた事柄。ならわし。「習慣・習性／悪習・因習・慣習・奇習・常習・俗習・風習」

coordinatorScan.method: All 1232 cards at 0eff2643: unguarded exact KANJIDIC2 gloss overlaps and content-token overlaps of KANJIDIC2 glosses plus displayed titles. Replaces the earlier unrecorded ad hoc scan.

督/帰.basis: KANJIDIC2 'lead to; result in' is the settling/belonging sense, not leading people.
sourceText: １ もとの所に戻る。かえる。「帰還・帰京・帰国・帰宅・帰路／回帰・不帰・復帰」
２ しかるべき所に落ち着く。「帰順・帰趨(きすう)・帰属・帰着・帰納」

監/法.basis: KANJIDIC2 'rule'; Daijisen おきて/規範. Same loose-'rule' category as the existing 規/則/律/典/準 guards.
sourceText: １ おきて。定め。秩序を維持するための規範。「法案・法学・法規・法人・法制・法則・法治・法廷・法典・法律・法令／悪法・違法・刑法・憲法・合法・国法・司法・適法・不法・民法・無法・理法・自然法」

監/儀.basis: KANJIDIC2 'rule'; Daijisen 見習うべき手本/模範, the same category as 典/準.
sourceText: ３ 見習うべき手本。模範。「儀表」

監/王.basis: KANJIDIC2 'rule' as exercising control; Daijisen 天子/君主. Conservative and qualified like the 仕 precedent: a monarch is not a supervisor.
sourceText: １ 天子。君主。「王侯・王国・王座・王子・王者・王女・王政・王妃／勤王(きんのう)・国王・女王・尊王(そんのう)・大王・帝王・仁王(におう)・覇王(はおう)・法王・魔王・四天王(してんのう)」

監/社.basis: KANJIDIC2 'office'; Daijisen 組合や団体などの機関 and the 会社 abbreviation. Consistent with the existing 院 institution guard; a company office is not a government office.
sourceText: ３ 組合や団体などの機関。「社中／会社・吟社・結社・公社・講社」
４ 世の中。「社会・社交」
５ 「会社」「新聞社」などの略。「社員・社説・社長／支社・商社・退社・入社・弊社」

監/更.basis: KANJIDIC2 'night watch' is a division of the night, not keeping watch.
sourceText: １ 新しいものと入れかわる。入れかえる。「更改・更新・更迭／変更」
２ 夜を五つに分けた時刻。「三更・初更」
３ ふける。「深更」
４ （「甦(そ)」の代用字）よみがえる。「更生」
〈さら〉「更地／今更」

監/over-only.basis: 凌, 曇, 渡, 考, 被, 越 and 駐 share only the particle-like token 'over' from 'watch over'; no oversight sense.

憲/数.basis: Daijisen gives number, counting, several, fate, scheme and the math abbreviation; no law sense.
sourceText: 〈スウ〉
１ かず。「数学・数字・数量／回数・偶数・計数・件数・算数・指数・小数・少数・整数・総数・多数・代数・点数・同数・人数(にんずう)・複数・分数」
２ かぞえること。計算。「無数」
３ 幾つかの。「数個・数次・数人・数年・数百」
４ めぐりあわせ。運命。「数奇(すうき)／命数」
５ はかりごと。たくらみ。「術数」
６ 「数学」の略。「理数科」
〈ス〉かず。「人数(にんず)」
〈かず〉「数数(かずかず)／頭数・口数・手数・場数」

reconciliationDirection.督: Add 連 and 養 with qualified note text and primary-source links. Optionally act on the report's urging-bullet split.
reconciliationDirection.監: Add 法, 儀, 王 and 社 with qualified note text and primary-source links.
reconciliationDirection.confirmations: A same-reviewer delta confirmation for 督 on the revision-006 HEAD; the 監 monitoring confirmation must be rebuilt on that HEAD and include the 監 delta.

acceptanceLimit: Mechanics and the reviewer's dispositions are accepted as evidence, but the candidate is not confirmed or publishable. Raw report bytes are preserved. No native/device acceptance.
